content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Activate the Smart Scheduler's Feature Toggle ## slug: msg-ss-activate-smart-scheduler-component ## seoTitle: Activate the Event Scheduler's Feature Toggle ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End To activate the Smart Scheduler's Feature Toggle, you can either contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} or follow the steps below. 1. Go to Setup. 2. In the Quick Find box, enter and click "Custom Metadata Types." 4. Click **Manage Records** next to Blackthorn Feature Toggle. 6. Click **Edit** next to Smart Scheduler Activation Record. 7. Check the {{variable.Field_FeatureToggle_Active}} checkbox. ![Activate Event Scheduler Comp 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Activate%20Event%20Scheduler%20Comp%201.png){height="" width=""} 8. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 9. Return to the Blackthorn | Scheduler Admin tab. 10. Refresh the page. 11. You will be taken to the Account Registration page. ![Activate Event Scheduler Comp 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Activate%20Event%20Scheduler%20Comp%202.png){height="" width=""}
